d: Bihar ke hajipur (vaishali) men lage duniya ke sabse bare bhuton ke mele se aastha aur andhvishvas se jure kaee anushthanon ki anokhi aur hairan karne vali tasviren samne aaee hain. mele men rat ke andhere men nadi ke pani men utarkar jhumti mahila tantrikon aur vibhinn prakar ke tantr-mantr va anushthan karte logon ka najara dekhne ko mil raha hai.
